notes: Identity checked in canonical source: An Agenda for Purely Confirmatory Research; Eric-Jan Wagenmakers, Ruud Wetzels, Denny Borsboom, Han L. J. van der Maas, and Rogier A. Kievit; DOI 10.1177/1745691612463078; Perspectives on Psychological Science 7(6), 632–638 (2012). This is the primary article reporting its own confirmatory replication. Text includes main article pages 632–638 and references; not an abstract or preregistration. Linked online appendix not supplied. No PDF assigned. Original source unassigned and not examined. Replication uses only neutral and erotic pictures, women only, in two sessions. Main article presents only analysis 6 (erotic pictures, combined sessions). Neutral-picture statistics and verdict require missing appendix. Candidate common experiment N is 100 women; 200 sessions are not 200 independent participants. No target-specific final N inferred, and no N sum or df inference performed. Bem findings on p. 635 are secondary original-study observations, not replication results. Authors explicitly decided not to compute p values for prespecified replication analyses.
